subject: S5 wounded-soldier request with no visible dialogue, compared with a prior successful interaction
scope: Read-only audit of one isolated copied-client accepted-1995 route and existing code/data. No live service, game content, DIT files, or copied database were changed for this audit.

latest_run.observation: The accepted client position was (-100.60547, 86.1875, 72.14453). The target view and right-click screenshot show a yellow marker and 'Press [Mouse Button 2] to talk'. Game log line 301 records Alden calling RequestNPCConverse at 2026-09-24 13:44:57.016 local time. No dialogue appeared, and copied character objective 1995/2 remained active. The archived log does not record the request's entity ID or an outgoing Converse packet.

successful_comparator.record: docs/evidence/bootcamp-s5-soldier-approach-20260924.json, observations citing run 63 and run 66; artifacts array entries for s5-route-probe-66
successful_comparator.finding: On a prior deployed-derived copied build, the original compatibility client displayed package-2584 Objective Completion dialogue. Clicking Continue sent CompleteNPCObjective, completed 1995/2, and activated 1995/3. The cited historical artifacts are currently unavailable at their recorded backup paths; this comparison relies on the dated evidence record and its recorded hashes.

code_and_data_audit.finding: The recovered client objective-conversation row binds mission 1995 objective 2 to NPC package 2584, player flag 1, conversation type 1.

The reconstructed wounded soldier is a creature NPC with package 2584 at (-102.4,86.09,70.0). The latest accepted client coordinate is about 2.8 m from that seed, but the target entity ID was not captured.

code_and_data_audit.source: src/Rasa.Game/Managers/NpcManager.cs, RequestNpcConverse lines 98-106 and 233; src/Rasa.Game/Managers/MissionManager.cs, AddMissionConversation lines 1542-1591
code_and_data_audit.finding: The server silently returns before sending Converse if the player is not in-world or the requested entity does not resolve to an NPC on the same channel. Otherwise it adds matching active-objective topics and sends Converse, even when the topic dictionary is empty. The request handler itself does not apply the conversation range gate.

assessment: One received RequestNPCConverse with no visible dialogue does not establish a mission data or gameplay-code defect. A previous copied-client interaction succeeded. The original client uses its current usable entity for the right-click request, and an empty or unsupported Converse dictionary can produce no visible dialogue (bootcamp-s5-converse-client-protocol-20260924.json). The missing target entity ID and outgoing reply trace prevent deciding whether this click selected the reconstructed soldier, hit a silent entity/channel guard, or got a reply without a matching topic. Do not change mission bindings, range, or content on this evidence.
next_verification: A later checkpointed copied-client trace (bootcamp-s5-soldier-converse-traced-checkpoint-20260924.json) resolved the soldier and rendered a correct objective-completion reply. The older uninterrupted failure still lacks entity/reply data; verify it only on a future bounded continuous run that actually reaches the soldier.
